payload.name: pc-contrast-06
payload.description: Raw records must be a list of 0..2 items. Every object has exactly code and enabled, code string length 2..5 inclusive, enabled exact bool (False valid). Always result={ok:boolean,records:original if valid else []}. Empty is valid; missing/null/wrong types/extra fields invalid without exceptions/coercion. No I/O/imports/host calls, no upstream validation assumption. Target inputs interface requires selected-runner support; unapproved draft, not submitted or activated.
